In this realistic sequence, 1. Aerial view drifting over a riverfront city at morning haze in cityscape with apartment towers, bridges, and multilane roads, 2. Drone camera circles above an elevated interchange in urban district with traffic, rooftops, and construction cranes, 3. A muddy river splits around sandbars in wetland plain with green fields and narrow roads, 4. Camera descends toward a confluence where brown water meets clear blue water in broad river bend with tree-lined banks, 5. Aerial view follows an S-shaped river through villages in valley with farmland, low hills, and scattered houses, 6. Drone glides beside a highway running parallel to river in landscape with fields, bridges, and small towns, 7. Two currents flow side by side before mixing in river channel with sharp color boundary and rippling surface, 8. Camera pans across levees and irrigation ditches in countryside with winding river and rectangular fields, 9. River widens into a reservoir in green basin with boats, roads, and forested slopes, 10. Aerial view crosses farmland blocks in rural plain with canals, farmhouses, and tree rows, 11. Drone flies over bright rice paddies in agricultural landscape with water reflections and narrow footpaths, 12. Camera tracks a rural road between ponds and fields in quiet village outskirts with power lines and small buildings, 13. Aerial view reveals terraced fields on hillside in farmland with layered crop patterns and stone paths, 14. Drone tilts down over geometric crop plots in countryside with irrigation grids and alternating green tones, 15. Visitors walk through archaeological park entrance in brick museum grounds with trees and stone pathways, 16. Group of tourists gathers outside a brick exhibition hall in museum courtyard with greenery and banners, 17. Camera moves inside excavation hall showing terracotta warriors in pits with wooden railings and museum lights, 18. Rows of clay statues stand in formation under high roof in Terracotta Army museum with columns, walkways, and deep excavation trenches.
